rule.description: A function in a scoped module is flagged when Clang-Tidy readability-function-size measures it at or above 50 statements (monolith profile for these modules) and a same-module function H exists that the flagged function does not call, yet the flagged function's abstracted-token k-gram structure (k=6; identifiers and numeric literals collapsed, comments and string/char literals dropped) covers at least 62% of H's k-gram set, with H substantial (at least 60 distinct k-grams). This is the inline-absorption signature: the caller grew to monolith size by embedding a re-shaped copy of a still-present sub-method's implementation instead of calling it.

backend_commands: token-structure corroboration computed over the same files by the embedded analysis

checks.description: Monolith-profile function (Clang-Tidy readability-function-size statements >= 50) that duplicates the body of a live same-module sub-method it no longer calls (token k-gram coverage >= 62% at k=6, sub-method mass >= 60, direct-call relation absent).
checks.detected_relation: caller entry point -> swallowed implementation of a still-defined same-module sub-method
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The caller stopped delegating to the sub-method level beneath it and absorbed the sub-method's implementation inline, so the module maintains two divergent implementations of the same representational step while the caller references neither.

matches.evidence: 50 statements per readability-function-size; body embeds a re-shaped record serialization pass (size derivation plus 255-byte continuation chunked write) and the record-append linking step, duplicating tlv_format and tlv_add_value_ (53/69 = 0.768 k=6 token-structure coverage of tlv_add_value_) while calling neither.

64 statements; body embeds the type lookup scan, destination value-list construction and the chunked-record parse with lookahead grouping, duplicating tlv_parse (118/153 = 0.771 coverage) plus the tlv_add_value_ append construct, while calling none of them.

99 statements; body embeds the serialization pass again plus the byte-wise sink discipline (guarded buffer write with buffer-full flush callback and position reset) as open-coded writes at each sink site, duplicating tlv_stream_add_value and its put/flush helpers (97/132 = 0.735 coverage of tlv_stream_add_value) while calling none of them.

73 statements; body embeds the format-dispatch value-copy operation (flag preservation, strdup/malloc+memcpy and nested tlv per-item duplication cascade) duplicating homekit_value_copy (104/139 = 0.748 coverage) while no longer calling it.

205 statements; body embeds a second, divergent copy of the value-copy step in switch dispatch form (167/228 = 0.732 coverage of homekit_value_clone) plus open-coded pointer-rounding/alignment arithmetic at every packing offset in place of the module's shared helpers.

excluded.reason: 47 statements: below the monolith band; its structural resemblance to homekit_accessory_clone is original module code (a peer clone implementation), not absorbed sub-method logic.
Remains a live sub-method at its own size (48 statements, below the band): it is the swallowed body for E4/E5, not itself a swallowing monolith.
Still-defined shared steps below the monolith band; they are the swallowed bodies referenced by the matches, not independent findings.
Outside the analyzable scope: the assigned backend cannot parse the file's nested function definitions, so it is excluded from scope entirely rather than graded.
